name: chess-trainer
description: Chess strategy trainer: the app, and the position finder that feeds it.

scripts.test:all: for t in smoke edge_cases my_games owner_seed owner_upgrade played_today fast_start profile_replay review_fixes lichess_link; do echo "== $t"; out=$(python3 tests/$t.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }; echo "$out" | tail -1; done
